name: onbox
description: Set up and run Onbox from your own agent: an always-on agent that answers your customers on every channel, learns how to handle each request, and leaves to you what it should not decide alone.

interface.longDescription: Onbox is the simplest way for a business to set up an always-on agent that answers its customers on every channel, such as email, website chat and social messaging. It learns how to handle each kind of request from your past conversations, your docs and the corrections you make, and it hands a person what it should not decide alone. This plugin lets your agent run Onbox for you: connect your channels and tools, build the Onbox agent's knowledge, finish the setup, then see and decide what is waiting on you. Connecting an account happens in your browser. Your agent can approve an action only after you confirm it. Requires an Onbox account; your agent acts only within the organisation you sign in to.
defaultPrompt: Set up Onbox for our customer support.
Go through what is waiting on me in Onbox.
Are there brain proposals to review in Onbox?
